courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
related.transfer: 可遷移「淹水深與共同基準」與「淺水傳播時間」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海堤越波模型試驗的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Submergence and shared datum" and "Shallow-water propagation time" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Overtopping model tests for seawalls must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結潛堤越頂透射缺口流與海岸地形的相互作用；海堤越波模型試驗則以以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect submerged-breakwater transmission, gap currents and evolving coastal morphology; Overtopping model tests for seawalls centres on interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「淹水深與共同基準」與「弗勞德縮尺條件」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海堤越波模型試驗，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「取樣頻帶配置」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Submergence and shared datum” and “Froude scaling conditions”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Overtopping model tests for seawalls, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Sampling bandwidth selection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 海岸養灘工程
related.transfer: 可遷移「淹水深與共同基準」與「淺水傳播時間」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；海岸養灘工程的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Submergence and shared datum" and "Shallow-water propagation time" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Beach nourishment must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦連結潛堤越頂透射缺口流與海岸地形的相互作用；海岸養灘工程則以以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on connect submerged-breakwater transmission, gap currents and evolving coastal morphology; Beach nourishment centres on distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「淹水深與共同基準」與「養灘幾何與方量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到海岸養灘工程，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「暴風後剖面恢復」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Submergence and shared datum” and “Nourishment geometry and volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Beach nourishment, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Post-storm profile recovery", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 離岸潛堤地形整合
history.text: 潛堤教學需要同時閱讀結構水理與地形監測，而不能以單一工程照片代表因果。美國官方目錄列二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊，香港手冊另整理海事結構方法並持續公布勘誤。荷蘭二〇一一年沙引擎是自然砂移動的比較案例，不是假稱有本課潛堤。錫爾迪金二〇一三年報告記錄博斯工程後的剖面與鄰岸變化，可用來討論岩礁、補灘和觀測期之間的關聯。紐比金離岸防波堤只比較遮蔽功能，沒有宣稱與博斯具有相同淹水幾何。所有透射、流量與剪力值均為合成教學情境。
history.textEn: Submerged-breakwater teaching requires structural hydraulics together with morphology monitoring; one project photograph cannot establish causation. The official US catalogue lists its2002 coastal manual, while Hong Kong maintains maritime guidance and corrigenda. The2011 Sand Motor compares natural sediment movement and is not claimed to contain the submerged structure modeled here. Ceredigion’s2013 report records profiles and neighboring changes after Borth works, supporting discussion of reefs, nourishment and observation periods. Newbiggin provides a sheltering-function comparison, without claiming identical submergence geometry. Every transmission, discharge and shear value in these lessons is a synthetic teaching assumption.
